recipe.name: Hearty Baked Beans with Poached Egg and Turkey Sausage

ingredients.name: canned baked beans (low sugar, no HFCS)

instructions: Dice onion and mince garlic. Heat olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Sauté onion and garlic until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add tomato paste, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt. Stir for 1 minute.
Add canned baked beans and rinsed white beans. Add 2 tablespoons water, stir, and simmer for 5-7 minutes until thickened.
Meanwhile, poach the egg in simmering water for 3-4 minutes until whites are set but yolk is runny.
Heat turkey sausage in a small pan or microwave until warmed through.
Serve beans in a bowl, top with sliced turkey sausage and the poached egg. Season with fresh pepper if desired.

recipe.name: Spicy Chicken and Avocado Whole Wheat Wrap
instructions: Cook chicken breast (if not pre-cooked) by boiling or grilling until done, then shred with two forks.
In a small bowl, mix shredded chicken with lime juice, cumin, chili powder, and salt.
In another bowl, combine Greek yogurt with diced jalapeno and cilantro to make a spicy sauce.
Lay the tortilla flat. Spread the yogurt sauce in the center.
Layer with shredded lettuce, diced tomato, black beans, avocado slices, and seasoned chicken.
Fold the sides of the tortilla in, then roll tightly from bottom to top.
Cut in half diagonally and serve immediately, or wrap in foil for later.

recipe.name: Korean Gochujang Chicken and Vegetable Traybake
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Line a large baking tray with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, minced garlic, and grated ginger to make the marinade.
Place chicken thighs in a bowl and pour half the marinade over them. Toss to coat and set aside.
On the prepared tray, spread cubed sweet potato, broccoli florets, sliced carrot, and red bell pepper. Drizzle remaining marinade over vegetables and toss to coat.
Place marinated chicken thighs among the vegetables in a single layer.
Roast for 20-25 minutes, stirring vegetables halfway through, until chicken is cooked through (internal temp 74°C) and vegetables are tender and caramelized.
Remove from oven and let rest 2 minutes. Sprinkle with sliced green onion and toasted sesame seeds.
Serve with cooked brown rice and kimchi on the side.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Greek Scramble with Feta and Spinach
instructions: Crack whole eggs into a bowl, add egg whites, and whisk until frothy.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add fresh spinach and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Pour in the egg mixture and stir gently with a spatula, pushing cooked eggs to the center.
When eggs are almost set, crumble feta cheese over the top and fold in gently.
Remove from heat when eggs are cooked to your liking (still slightly moist).
Toast whole wheat bread and slice tomato. Serve scramble alongside toast and tomato slices.

recipe.name: Middle Eastern Grilled Lamb Kofta with Roasted Vegetables and Tahini Sauce
instructions: In a bowl, combine ground lamb, grated onion, parsley, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Mix well and form into 4 elongated kofta shapes on skewers (if using).
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Grill kofta for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through and nicely charred.
Meanwhile, toss cubed eggplant, zucchini, and red bell pepper with 10g olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast in a 200°C oven for 20 minutes, turning once halfway.
For the tahini sauce: whisk together tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, remaining 5g olive oil, and water until smooth and creamy. Add more water if needed for desired consistency.
Serve grilled kofta alongside roasted vegetables, drizzled with tahini sauce.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Keto Vanilla-Almond Protein Shake
instructions: Add all ingredients to a high-speed blender.
Blend on high for 45–60 seconds until completely smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Italian Sausage and Broccoli Rabe Stir Fry
instructions: Trim tough stems from broccoli rabe and blanch in boiling salted water for 2 minutes, then drain well.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat.
Add ground sausage and cook, breaking apart with a spatula, for 5–6 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add garlic and red pepper flakes, stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add blanched broccoli rabe and toss with sausage for 2 minutes over high heat.
Season with salt, remove from heat, and fold in grated pecorino romano.
Serve immediately hot.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Greek Yoghurt Bowl with Almonds, Walnuts and Mixed Berries
instructions: Place the Greek yoghurt in a serving bowl.
Sprinkle the almonds, walnuts, hemp seeds, chia seeds and pumpkin seeds over the yoghurt.
Add the frozen mixed berries on top.
Dust with ground cinnamon and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Herb-Crusted Lamb Leg with Roasted Mediterranean Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C (fan).
In a small bowl, mix the minced garlic, dried oregano, dried thyme, chopped rosemary, lemon juice, 10g of the olive oil, salt and black pepper into a paste.
Rub the herb paste all over the lamb leg and set aside to marinate while you prepare the vegetables.
In a large roasting tray, combine the diced eggplant, zucchini, red bell pepper, red onion, cherry tomatoes and potatoes.
Drizzle the remaining 8g olive oil over the vegetables, season with a pinch of salt and pepper, and toss well.
Place the marinated lamb leg on top of the vegetables in the centre of the tray.
Roast for 25–30 minutes for medium-rare (internal temp 55–58°C) or 35 minutes for medium (60–63°C).
Remove from the oven, transfer the lamb to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the lamb against the grain into 1cm thick slices.
Divide the roasted vegetables and lamb slices between plates and serve immediately.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Smoked Mackerel and Avocado Plate
instructions: Place the smoked mackerel fillet on a plate.
Slice the avocado thinly and arrange alongside the fish.
Dot the mackerel with small pieces of butter.
Squeeze lemon juice over the avocado and mackerel.
Season with a pinch of salt and black pepper to taste.

recipe.name: Vietnamese Braised Pork Belly (Thịt Kho Tàu)
instructions: Cut pork belly into 2cm cubes. Rub with salt and pepper.
Heat coconut oil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sliced shallot, fry until fragrant.
Add pork belly and sear on all sides until golden.
Add coconut aminos, fish sauce, and pork bone broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and braise for 1.5 to 2 hours until meat is tender.
Add the halved hard-boiled egg in the last 15 minutes of cooking.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Serve hot.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Smoky Baked Beans with Poached Eggs and Spinach

ingredients.name: canned white beans (cannellini, no added salt)

instructions: Finely dice the onion and garlic.
Heat olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Sauté onion and garlic until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add smoked paprika, ground cumin, and black pepper; stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add tomato passata, water, and drained white beans. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in diced turkey breast and cook for 2 minutes to heat through. Season with salt to taste.
Meanwhile, bring a small pot of water to a gentle simmer. Poach the eggs for 3-4 minutes until whites are set but yolks are still runny.
Wilt the spinach in a pan with a splash of water for 1 minute.
Serve the baked beans in a bowl, topped with wilted spinach and poached eggs.

recipe.name: Smoky BBQ Beef Curry with Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Cut beef chuck into 2 cm cubes. Peel and dice sweet potato into 1 cm cubes.
Heat olive oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat. Brown beef cubes on all sides (about 4 minutes). Remove and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium. Add diced onion and minced garlic; sauté for 3 minutes until soft.
Stir in tomato paste, molasses, apple cider vinegar, smoked paprika, cumin, chili powder, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Return beef to pot. Add beef stock and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook for 45 minutes.
Add sweet potato cubes, cover, and continue simmering for 20 minutes until beef is tender and sweet potato is cooked.
Meanwhile, thinly shred cabbage and grate carrot. Toss with lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Season beef curry with salt to taste. Serve alongside cabbage slaw and a dollop of Greek yogurt.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Cheesy Egg Scramble with Butter and Cream
instructions: Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk thoroughly with a pinch of salt and pepper until frothy.
Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat.
Pour in the eggs and let them set for 30 seconds, then gently stir with a spatula, pulling cooked egg from edges toward center.
When eggs are softly set but still slightly wet, add heavy cream and grated cheddar. Stir gently until cheese melts and eggs are creamy.
Remove from heat immediately (carryover cooking continues) and serve hot.

recipe.name: Cajun Blackened Salmon with Roasted Okra and Bell Pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Mix smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, oregano, thyme, and salt in a small bowl to make the Cajun spice blend.
Pat salmon dry with paper towels. Coat both sides generously with the spice blend, pressing it in.
Trim okra stems and slice into 2cm pieces. Slice bell pepper into strips. Toss vegetables with 1 tbsp avocado oil and a pinch of salt.
Spread vegetables on a baking sheet in a single layer. Place seasoned salmon skin-side down in the center of the sheet.
Roast for 12-14 minutes, until salmon is cooked through and flakes easily, and vegetables are tender with charred edges.
In the last 2 minutes, dot butter over the salmon to melt. Serve immediately with the roasted vegetables.
